industry.description: The specific vertical market or economic sector the company operates in. (Note: Do NOT use for horizontal business models like B2B or B2C; those belong to target_audience).

core_technology.description: The main underlying technological infrastructure used by the company. (Note: Do NOT use for business models like SaaS. Map AI/ML to 'ai_ml').

product_type.description: The structural archetype of the product or service offered.

target_audience.description: The primary group of customers or users the company aims to serve (Captures B2B/B2C orientation).

monetization_strategy.description: The primary method through which the company generates revenue.

delivery_medium.description: The primary medium or channel through which the company's product or service is delivered.

value_proposition.description: The main operational benefit or advantage offered by the company's product or service.

regulatory_environment.description: The specific regulatory or legal compliance domain the company directly operates within.
